description: Phase 6 reasoner-native QA set: extends the P5 mixed set with entity-on-entity support (ON_ENTITY_SURFACE / SUPPORTS-over-entity). Q1/Q2/Q4/Q5/Q6 are unchanged-behavior regression rows; Q3 'on the table?' flips defer -> answer; Q7 'on the chair?' is a new honest-EMPTY row (the system answers and nothing qualifies, distinct from a defer). NOT comparable to the v1 benchmark, and NOT comparable to the P5 6/6 scorecard -- the question set changed (see phase6_eval_definition_change).

phase6_eval_definition_change.statement: Q3 'what is on the table?' changes from expected_outcome 'defer' (P5) to 'answer' (P6) because EntitySurface furniture-top support now exists. Q7 'what is on the chair?' is new (expected 'empty'). This is a Phase 6 eval-DEFINITION change, not a benchmark accuracy improvement: the P5 scorecard (6/6) and the P6 scorecard are different question sets and are not directly comparable. The P5 fixture and the P5 QA artifact remain byte-frozen.

score_categories.true_answer: expected answer; system answered; cited entities cover expected_must_contain and include none of expected_must_not_contain
score_categories.false_answer: system answered when expected was defer/empty (fabricated fact), OR answered including a must_not_contain entity
score_categories.miss: expected answer; system answered but missed an expected_must_contain entity (or returned empty/unknown)
score_categories.correct_defer: expected defer; system deferred (out_of_schema -> abstain with a deferred: note)
score_categories.true_empty: expected empty; system answered with zero bindings (answerable, nothing qualifies) -- NOT a defer
score_categories.unexpected: outcome did not match the expected category; carries the actual outcome for attribution

grounding_note: All expected_must_contain entities were verified by measurement against the live enriched-v2 bundle with the real rest_contact predicate before freezing. Q3 table-support set = the exactly five table-class rests under the frozen 0.02/0.03 band (book_1/obj_92->table_5 -0.0077, book_2/obj_90->table_1 -0.007, book_4/obj_12->table_4 -0.010, book_7/obj_59->table_4 +0.007, lamp_1/obj_87->table_1 -0.013). The pot (obj_43, +0.0349) is band-excluded and appears in NEITHER list (documented borderline). Q7 'on the chair' is empty: no portable object rests on either chair (obj_73/obj_74) under the band.

questions.question: what is on the floor?
questions.notes: Regression: the Phase 4 floor-support path must still work unchanged. obj_39 (stool) is a known floor rest.

questions.question: what is against the wall?
questions.notes: Regression: the Phase 5 wall-contact path unchanged. obj_6 (lamp) is the only real wall contact; picture/pillar/window must not appear.

questions.question: what is on the table?
questions.notes: CHANGED defer -> answer (Phase 6). The five table rests (4 books + 1 lamp) under the frozen band. obj_39 (stool) is a floor supporter, never ON a table -> must_not_contain. The pot (obj_43, band-excluded float) is intentionally in neither list.

questions.question: what is left of the blanket?
questions.notes: Regression: entity<->entity directional path. obj_86 (blanket) has exactly one LEFT_OF source: obj_39 (stool).

questions.question: what is near the wall?
questions.notes: Regression: SurfaceRef-anchored NEAR_SURFACE. obj_2 (cabinet) is near a wall. Distinct from Q2: 'near' is proximity, 'against' is contact.

questions.question: what is attached to the wall?
questions.notes: UNCHANGED defer. Attachment stays deferred in P6: room_0 has zero honest wall-contact-AND-elevated positives (the only wall contact, obj_6, is a floor-standing lamp). Answering this with anything would be unearned attachment. 'against' != 'attached'; 'on a table' != 'attached to a wall'.

questions.question: what is on the chair?
questions.notes: NEW honest-EMPTY row. EntitySurface support exists for chairs (obj_73/obj_74 are in the support-class allowlist and get derived tops), but nothing rests on them under the band. The system must ANSWER with zero bindings (true_empty), NOT defer. This separates 'answered, nothing qualifies' from 'cannot answer' -- the value of having the relation even when the answer is empty.
